12: Definition (scale S1 = 1m bars with half-window H=15; S5 = 5m bars with H=12, i.e. 15 min / 60 min halves):
13:   at the close of bar t, LONG divergence ("price lower low, CVD higher low") when ALL hold:
14:     a. min(low[t-H+1..t]) < min(low[t-2H+1..t-H])            price made a lower low in the recent half
15:     b. the recent-half low is in the last 3 bars              we are at the low now (no hindsight pivot)
16:     c. close[t] < close[t-4H] * (1 - CTX)                     falling context (CTX 0.25% S1, 0.5% S5)
17:     d. min(cvd[t-H+1..t]) > min(cvd[t-2H+1..t-H])            CVD did NOT make a lower low (cvd = bar-close values)
18:   CONTROL = a+b+c without d (every lower low at the low in a falling context).  CONFIRM = a+b+c and NOT d.
19:   SHORT is the mirror (higher high, CVD lower high, rising context).
20:   Entry = open of the next 1m bar. Cooldown 120 min per side and per arm. Fee 0.05% per side (0.10% round trip).
21:   Outcomes: forward return at 30/60/120 min (net), and a trade: stop 0.1% beyond the recent-half extreme, target 2R,
22:   time exit 120 min, checked on 1m bars (stop first when both are hit in one minute).
23:   OI split (only where OI exists, 2025-09+): OI change over the 60 min to the bar close > 0 (UP) or <= 0 (DOWN).
25:   Edge rule (fixed before the run): DIV minus CONTROL at 60 min >= +0.05% net on DEV with Welch t >= 2, and the same
26:   sign on VAL and HOLDOUT. Anything else = no edge.
